units.applicability: Proposed permanent rules, in accordance with ESSB 6260 (2026) and RCW 28A.300.072.
units.assertion: OSPI proposes to amend chapter 392-425 WAC to authorize local education agencies to charge sliding scale fees for TK enrollment.

evidence.quote: Purpose of the Proposal and Its Anticipated Effects, Including Any Changes in Existing Rules: In accordance with ESSB 6260 (2026) and RCW  28A.300.072, OSPI is proposing to amend chapter 392-425 WAC to adopt permanent rules authorizing local education agencies to charge sliding scale fees for enrollment in the transition to kindergarten (TK) program and to establish rules related to the allocation of state funding for TK programs. Permanent rule adoption is necessary to implement statutory changes enacted by the Washington state legislature, and to ensure school districts, charter schools, and state-tribal education compact schools have the rules and guidance necessary for implementation during the 2027-28 school year, including enrollment, budgeting, and program planning timelines.

Reasons Supporting Proposal: OSPI is proposing permanent amendments to chapter 392-425 WAC to implement ESSB 6260 (2026) and RCW  28A.300.072, including rules that allow local education agencies to charge sliding scale fees for TK and establish criteria for state funding allocations. Timely rule adoption is needed so districts, charter schools, and state-tribal education compact schools can plan for enrollment, staffing, budgeting, and implementation for the 2027-28 school year.
